sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (WRNF '2026 Campground and Day Use Area Operating Dates')

values.note: Electric and water at sites 1-19 (Allgeier and Osgood loops), for an extra fee; no hookups in the Mechau loop (water from hydrants). The catalog types 16 of the 17 electric sites as 15-amp and one (005) as 30/50.

hookups.source: FS page ('Water available at site hook-up for sites 1 through 19 and from hydrants for sites 21 through 38'; 'Sites 1 through 19 have cold running water and electrical hook-ups for an extra fee') + rec.gov notice ('Electric and water hook-ups are only available in the Allgeier and Osgood Loops; there are no hook-ups available in the Mechau Loop') + rec.gov catalog (Electricity Hookup 15 at 16 sites, 30/50 at site 005), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 37 sites plus 2 host sites (20 and 39). 40-ft maximum RV length including the tow vehicle. Gravel spurs, a few pull-throughs in Osgood and Mechau.

sites.source: FS page ('The Redstone Campground offers 37 campsites plus 2 host sites (20 & 39)'; '40-foot maximum RV length') + rec.gov notice ('Maximum RV length is 40 feet including tow vehicle') + rec.gov catalog (Driveway Entry Pull-Through at 21, 28, 30, 33, 34/35, 010, 015, 017), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Showers in the Osgood loop (the Mechau loop's showers are closed for the near future). One flush-toilet bathroom plus composting/vault toilets. Playground, picnic shelter, horseshoe pits, basketball court; firewood sold on site.

facilities.source: FS page ('One bathroom with flush toilet, hot and cold running water, and showers'; 'Showers are available in the Osgood Loop; Showers in the Mechau loop will not be open for the near future'; 'Potable water is available at this site') + rec.gov notice ('No dump station on site'), read 2026-10-27

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('Aspen & Sopris Redstone I CG (Allgeier/Osgood) 7,200 39/60' 5/13-10/2 $47*'; 'Redstone II CG (Mechau) 39/60' 5/13-9/24 $40*'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov at least two days ahead; 14 consecutive nights, 14 nights a month at most. Occupy the site the first night (held until 11 a.m. the next day). One RV per single site, two per double; an extra vehicle is charged nightly at the campground. Run by a concessionaire (American Land & Leisure, 801-226-3564).

booking.source: rec.gov rules (reservationCutOff 2; maxConsecutiveStay 14; maxStay 14 'Each Month'; minWeekendStay/minHolidayWeekendStay 0 'soft' = no rule) + rates (2026 Peak Season 2026-05-13 to 2026-10-01) + notices ('Reserved Sites will be held until check out time (ELEVEN) the day following your arrival date'; 'One RV per single site, two RV'S per double site'; 'Customer Service Contact 801-226-3564'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: $38 a single non-electric site, $45 electric (2026); doubles $77 / $91. Extra vehicle charged nightly at the campground.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232329/rates (2026 Peak Season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 38, STANDARD ELECTRIC 45) + FS page ('Single Site: $38 per night (non-electric), $45 per night (electric) Double Site: $77 per night (non-electric), $91 per night (electric)'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Senior pass must be entered when booking; single sites only.

discounts.source: rec.gov notice ('Any accepted senior passes must be entered for the discount at the time of booking for single sites only'), read 2026-10-27

note: Aspen-Sopris Ranger District campground (White River NF) on a ridge above the Crystal River at the north entrance to Redstone, off Highway 133; aspen groves, red-rock cliff views. Hookups only in the Allgeier and Osgood loops. --Claude
summary: FS page + WRNF 2026 table + rec.gov: confirmed reservable on rec.gov, $38-45 (2026), water at the electric sites. Changed sites 31 -> 37 (FS) and max rig 65 -> 40 ft (FS and rec.gov both state a 40-ft limit incl. tow). Added pull-through, showers/flush toilets/potable water/no dump, season 05-13 to 10-02, booking season, 14-night max, Senior discount. Electric 50 left (derived from the catalog's one 30/50 site; see flag).
flags: Phone missing: rec.gov lists 970-927-0107 (REDSTONE) and the Aspen-Sopris Ranger District mailing address PO Box 309, Carbondale; concessionaire American Land & Leisure 801-226-3564. I did not read the district office page this run.
Website is the recreation.gov listing; the FS campground page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/redstone-campground.

Amperage: stored electric 50 rests on one catalog site (005, 'Electricity Hookup 30/50', and that site's water reads 'No' though the FS page says sites 1-19 all have water). The other 16 electric sites are catalogued at 15 amps. No page states the amperage; 15 may be the real figure for almost every site. Left at 50.
Fee conflict: rec.gov and the FS page say $38 / $45 for 2026; the forest's 2026 operating-dates table says $47 (Redstone I, electric) and $40 (Redstone II). Recorded rec.gov's $38-45.

Length/count conflict: the forest's table says 39 sites / 60 ft for each of Redstone I and II; the FS page and rec.gov notice say a 40-ft maximum RV length including tow. Recorded 40. The rec.gov description says 35 sites (17 electric), the catalog has 31 bookable plus 6 management sites, and the FS page 37 plus 2 hosts. Recorded 37.
Pin checked: 122 m from the centroid of the 30 site coordinates (39.20110,-107.23013), so fine; the stored pin is rounded (39.2000,-107.2300). The FS page gives 39.200531,-107.231531.
Closed now for the season (2026 dates 5/13-10/2).
